## Error handler
Runs when a workflow that names this one as its errorWorkflow fails. Load config outputs only { config }, so Shape alert input reads the Error Trigger's fields back by name next to team_locale. Render error alert (generated from src/nodes/error-alert.ts) builds a plain-text alert in the team's language with the failed node, the error, the execution URL, and the time in Bogota. This workflow names no errorWorkflow of its own, so a failure here can't loop.
